negatief, en reduksie vind daar plaas.
positief, en reduksie vind daar plaas.

sections.title: Physical properties of organic compounds

questions.q: Define the term vapour pressure.
questions.qAf: Definieer die term dampdruk.
points: The pressure exerted by a vapour at equilibrium with its liquid
pointsAf: Die druk wat deur ’n damp in ewewig met sy vloeistof uitgeoefen word

questions.q: Why were compounds with similar molar masses chosen for this comparison?
questions.qAf: Waarom is verbindings met soortgelyke molêre massas vir hierdie vergelyking gekies?
points: So that the strength of the London (dispersion) forces is about the same, and only the functional group affects the boiling point (fair test)
pointsAf: Sodat die sterkte van die London-kragte (dispersiekragte) omtrent dieselfde is en net die funksionele groep die kookpunt beïnvloed (regverdige toets)

questions.q: Explain the difference between the boiling points of butanal and butan-1-ol. Refer to the type and strength of the intermolecular forces.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die verskil tussen die kookpunte van butanaal en butan-1-ol. Verwys na die soort en sterkte van die intermolekulêre kragte.
points: Butanal has dipole-dipole forces (and London forces) between its molecules
butan-1-ol has hydrogen bonds between its molecules
hydrogen bonds are stronger than dipole-dipole forces
so more energy is needed to overcome the forces in butan-1-ol
pointsAf: Butanaal het dipool-dipoolkragte (en London-kragte) tussen sy molekules
butan-1-ol het waterstofbindings tussen sy molekules
dus is meer energie nodig om die kragte in butan-1-ol te oorkom

questions.q: Which compound in the table has the highest vapour pressure at room temperature? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Watter verbinding in die tabel het die hoogste dampdruk by kamertemperatuur? Gee ’n rede.
points: it has only weak London forces between its molecules (the weakest intermolecular forces / lowest boiling point)
pointsAf: dit het net swak London-kragte tussen sy molekules (die swakste intermolekulêre kragte / laagste kookpunt)

questions.q: Explain why propanoic acid has a higher boiling point than butan-1-ol.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom propanoësuur ’n hoër kookpunt as butan-1-ol het.
points: Propanoic acid has two sites for hydrogen bonding (it forms dimers)
so its intermolecular forces are stronger and more energy is needed to overcome them
pointsAf: Propanoësuur het twee plekke vir waterstofbinding (dit vorm dimere)
dus is sy intermolekulêre kragte sterker en is meer energie nodig om hulle te oorkom

questions.q: Which has the higher boiling point: hexane or 2-methylpentane? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Watter een het die hoër kookpunt: heksaan of 2-metielpentaan? Gee ’n rede.
points: hexane: it is unbranched, has a larger contact surface and so stronger London forces
pointsAf: heksaan: dit is onvertak, het ’n groter kontakoppervlak en dus sterker London-kragte

sections.intro:
Study the reactions below.
Reaction 1: but-1-ene + H₂O (H₃PO₄ catalyst) → butan-2-ol
Reaction 2: butan-2-ol + concentrated H₂SO₄ (heat) → but-2-ene + water
Reaction 3: 2-bromobutane + dilute NaOH (mild heat) → butan-2-ol
Reaction 4: 2-bromobutane + concentrated KOH in ethanol (strong heat) → but-2-ene
sections.introAf:
Bestudeer die reaksies hieronder.
Reaksie 1: but-1-een + H₂O (H₃PO₄-katalisator) → butan-2-ol
Reaksie 2: butan-2-ol + gekonsentreerde H₂SO₄ (hitte) → but-2-een + water
Reaksie 3: 2-broombutaan + verdunde NaOH (matige hitte) → butan-2-ol
Reaksie 4: 2-broombutaan + gekonsentreerde KOH in etanol (sterk hitte) → but-2-een

sections.title: Rate of reaction

questions.q: Define reaction rate.
questions.qAf: Definieer reaksietempo.
points: The change in concentration (amount/mass/volume) of reactants or products
pointsAf: Die verandering in konsentrasie (hoeveelheid/massa/volume) van reaktante of produkte

questions.q: Write down the independent variable in this investigation.
questions.qAf: Skryf die onafhanklike veranderlike in hierdie ondersoek neer.
points: the concentration of the hydrochloric acid

questions.q: Use the collision theory to explain why the reaction in experiment II is faster.
questions.qAf: Gebruik die botsingsteorie om te verduidelik waarom die reaksie in eksperiment II vinniger is.
points: A higher concentration means more acid particles per unit volume
so there are more collisions per unit time
and more effective collisions per unit time
pointsAf: ’n Hoër konsentrasie beteken meer suurdeeltjies per eenheidvolume
dus is daar meer botsings per eenheidtyd
en meer effektiewe botsings per eenheidtyd

questions.q: Show by calculation that the hydrochloric acid in experiment I is in excess.
questions.qAf: Toon deur berekening dat die soutsuur in eksperiment I in oormaat is.
points: n(HCl) available = 1 × 0,15 = 0,15 mol > 0,12 mol, so HCl is in excess
pointsAf: n(HCl) beskikbaar = 1 × 0,15 = 0,15 mol > 0,12 mol, dus is HCl in oormaat

questions.q: Calculate the mass of CO₂ produced when all the MgCO₃ has reacted.
questions.qAf: Bereken die massa CO₂ wat geproduseer word wanneer al die MgCO₃ gereageer het.

questions.q: Experiment II is complete after 75 s. Calculate the average rate of CO₂ production in mol·s⁻¹.
questions.qAf: Eksperiment II is ná 75 s voltooi. Bereken die gemiddelde tempo van CO₂-produksie in mol·s⁻¹.

questions.q: Experiment I is repeated with MgCO₃ lumps of the same mass instead of powder. How will the rate change? Explain.
questions.qAf: Eksperiment I word herhaal met MgCO₃-stukke van dieselfde massa in plaas van poeier. Hoe sal die tempo verander? Verduidelik.
points: the lumps have a smaller surface area, so there are fewer effective collisions per unit time
pointsAf: die stukke het ’n kleiner reaksie-oppervlak, dus is daar minder effektiewe botsings per eenheidtyd

sections.intro:
Learners react 5 g of magnesium carbonate powder with 150 cm³ of hydrochloric acid at 25 °C:
MgCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) + CO₂(g)
In experiment I the acid has a concentration of 1 mol·dm⁻³ and in experiment II a concentration of 2 mol·dm⁻³.
sections.introAf:
Leerders laat 5 g magnesiumkarbonaatpoeier met 150 cm³ soutsuur by 25 °C reageer:
MgCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) + CO₂(g)
In eksperiment I het die suur ’n konsentrasie van 1 mol·dm⁻³ en in eksperiment II ’n konsentrasie van 2 mol·dm⁻³.

sections.title: Chemical equilibrium

questions.q: State Le Chatelier's principle.
questions.qAf: Stel Le Chatelier se beginsel.
points: When the equilibrium in a closed system is disturbed
the system re-instates a new equilibrium by favouring the reaction that opposes the disturbance
pointsAf: Wanneer die ewewig in ’n geslote sisteem versteur word
stel die sisteem ’n nuwe ewewig in deur die reaksie te bevoordeel wat die versteuring teenwerk

questions.q: Calculate the equilibrium constant K_c at temperature T.
questions.qAf: Bereken die ewewigskonstante K_c by temperatuur T.

questions.q: The temperature is increased. Will the value of K_c INCREASE, DECREASE or STAY THE SAME? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die temperatuur word verhoog. Sal die waarde van K_c TOENEEM, AFNEEM of DIESELFDE BLY? Verduidelik.
points: the forward reaction is endothermic, so it is favoured
the concentrations of the products increase and that of the reactant decreases
pointsAf: die voorwaartse reaksie is endotermies, dus word dit bevoordeel
die konsentrasies van die produkte neem toe en dié van die reaktant neem af

questions.q: The volume of the container is decreased at constant temperature. How will this affect the amount of Cl₂ at equilibrium? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die volume van die houer word by konstante temperatuur verklein. Hoe sal dit die hoeveelheid Cl₂ by ewewig beïnvloed? Verduidelik.
points: the pressure increases, so the reaction that produces fewer moles of gas is favoured
the reverse reaction (1 mol gas on the left, 2 mol on the right)
pointsAf: die druk neem toe, dus word die reaksie wat minder mol gas lewer, bevoordeel
die terugwaartse reaksie (1 mol gas links, 2 mol regs)

questions.q: A catalyst is added to the system at equilibrium. How does this affect the amount of Cl₂? Explain.
questions.qAf: ’n Katalisator word by die stelsel in ewewig gevoeg. Hoe beïnvloed dit die hoeveelheid Cl₂? Verduidelik.
points: a catalyst increases the rates of the forward and reverse reactions equally
pointsAf: ’n katalisator verhoog die tempo’s van die voorwaartse en terugwaartse reaksies ewe veel

sections.intro:
0,8 mol PCl₅(g) is sealed in an empty 2 dm³ container at temperature T. The reaction reaches equilibrium:
PCl₅(g) ⇌ PCl₃(g) + Cl₂(g) ΔH > 0
At equilibrium the container holds 0,3 mol Cl₂(g).
sections.introAf:
0,8 mol PCl₅(g) word in ’n leë houer van 2 dm³ by temperatuur T verseël. Die reaksie bereik ewewig:
PCl₅(g) ⇌ PCl₃(g) + Cl₂(g) ΔH > 0
By ewewig bevat die houer 0,3 mol Cl₂(g).

questions.q: 40 cm³ of HCl(aq) of concentration 0,25 mol·dm⁻³ is mixed with 60 cm³ of NaOH(aq) of concentration 0,2 mol·dm⁻³. Calculate the pH of the mixture.

sections.title: Electrolytic cells

questions.q: Define an electrolyte.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n elektroliet.
points: A substance whose solution or melt conducts electricity
pointsAf: ’n Stof waarvan die oplossing of smelt elektrisiteit gelei

questions.q: Is the impure copper the anode or the cathode?

questions.q: Write down the half-reaction at the cathode.

questions.q: Explain why the concentration of Cu²⁺ ions in the electrolyte stays about the same.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die konsentrasie Cu²⁺-ione in die elektroliet omtrent dieselfde bly.
points: Cu is oxidised to Cu²⁺ at the anode
at the same rate as Cu²⁺ is reduced to Cu at the cathode
pointsAf: Cu word by die anode tot Cu²⁺ geoksideer
teen dieselfde tempo as wat Cu²⁺ by die katode tot Cu gereduseer word

questions.q: Impurities such as silver and gold collect under the anode. Explain why they are not oxidised.
questions.qAf: Onsuiwerhede soos silwer en goud versamel onder die anode. Verduidelik waarom hulle nie geoksideer word nie.
points: Silver and gold are weaker reducing agents than copper
so they are not oxidised and fall as anode sludge
pointsAf: Silwer en goud is swakker reduseermiddels as koper
dus word hulle nie geoksideer nie en val as anodeslik
